messages:
mwest: FYI support ticket DEV-11842 — customer reports missing audit events in their SIEM export since yesterday morning. They say some users' session_open and config_change events are gone.
sophia: Can you paste the example event IDs they say are missing? If we can find them in raw stream we can trace where they dropped.
support-liaison: Putting sample from customer: event_ids: ["evt_8a3f2c", "evt_8a3f2d"], tenant: acme-corp-prod, time range: 2026-03-15T02:00Z - 2026-03-15T06:00Z. They forwarded the SIEM ingest manifest and a partial gz file (attached).
mwest: Thanks. I searched hot storage — found evt_8a3f2c in audit-raw/day=2026-03-15/part-0007.gz but the export manifest that ran for tenant acme-corp-prod at 03:15 shows a zero-byte batch: s3://exports/acme-corp/2026-03-15/03/manifest-03.json -> batch id b-4921 size 0
nate_sre: Zero-byte could be due to the forwarder skipping on KMS decrypt error. Check forwarder logs around 03:14: `auditpipe-worker` on node gpu-export-12.
audit-bot: deploy/auditpipe-worker@gpu-export-12 started 2026-03-15T02:55:12Z
sophia: I pulled worker logs: `ERROR KMSDecrypt failed AccessDeniedException for key alias/tenant-acme` and shortly after `Skipping batch b-4921: zero-byte after rewrap`.
support-liaison: Customer says they rotated their key the night before and didn't update our tenancy binding — possible mismatch.
mwest: OK that explains missing events in that batch. But still odd there are other missing events later in the window where key bindings were correct. Could be late-arrival trimming by retention TTL.
nate_sre: Which retention settings were in play? If the export job's window computation runs with a TTL cut (we had an edge-case where late events older than export_window + ttl_grace got dropped before batching).
sophia: Checking pipeline config for tenant config: acme-corp-prod had `export_window = 300s`, `ttl_grace = 120s`, `replay_cutoff = 3600s` (default). The missing evt_8a3f2d timestamp is 4,100s behind export job run -> exceeds replay_cutoff, so it wouldn't be included in scheduled export.
support-liaison: Customer insists these are not "late" — they show as ingested at 03:10 in our raw index. Could be index vs event timestamp mismatch (ingestion vs event_ts).
mwest: Can we reproduce? Steps I used:
1) run `aws s3 cp s3://audit-raw/day=2026-03-15/part-0007.gz - | zcat | jq -r 'select(.id=="evt_8a3f2c")'`
2) confirm event present and event_ts.
3) look up export manifest for same tenant and time `s3://exports/acme-corp/2026-03-15/03/manifest-03.json` and `jq .batches[] | select(.id=="b-4921")`
4) tail `kubectl logs -n exports deploy/auditpipe-worker -c forwarder --since=30m | grep b-4921`
nate_sre: I ran repro in staging with a rotated key — reproduced zero-byte and KMS AccessDenied in forwarder logs. Root cause: when a customer rotates a KMS alias without sending a Rekey webhook, the forwarder attempts a decrypt with the old key ARN which fails at HSM policy level for cross-account alias rotation. We have a mitigation: detect AccessDenied on decrypt and escalate to scheduled rewrap worker instead of skipping batch.
sophia: Good catch. For customer fix: (A) rebind alias in tenant console or (B) run the rewrap playbook: `POST /internal/exports/reauth?tenant=acme-corp-prod` which triggers immediate rewrap + re-export for the last 6h. Will attach support runbook steps.
support-liaison: Sent rewrap job to customer and requested they confirm when SIEM manifests show non-zero batch. Also asked for sample of other missing event IDs.
mwest: After rewrap we should run a small verification: fetch manifest and the specific gz paths and confirm decrypted file sizes >0 and events present. Example check:
```
aws s3 cp s3://exports/acme-corp/2026-03-15/03/b-4921.gz - | zcat | head -n 5
```
nate_sre: I'll file a follow-up ticket INF-5213 to change forwarder behavior: on KMS AccessDenied -> mark batch as pending and queue to rewrap-run instead of marking zero-byte. Also add metric `forwarder.kms_access_denied.count` and alert on >5/min for a tenant.
sophia: Also add a support-facing message when rewrap required: `Your export has pending batches due to key rotation; rewrap requested`. Small UX tweak.
support-liaison: Customer confirmed rewrap succeeded and sent manifest with b-4921 size 128K and event evt_8a3f2c present. Closing immediate customer impact. Leaving INF-5213 for engineering to prevent recurrence. :thumbsup:
mwest: Thanks team — please link INF-5213 and mark customer as impacted in the postmortem if we don't have rewrap telemetry in 24h.
